description: START KEY ... WITH LENGTH phrase (variable-length key comparison), ISO 14.9.41.2 prints it as `[ WITH LENGTH arithmetic-expression-1 ]` - a COBOL-2002 introduction. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): ANSI X3.23-1985's indexed START has no LENGTH phrase: a partial key is a shorter data-name-1 ('whose length is not greater than the length of that record key', §1985:IX.4.7.3 SR4b) and the comparison truncates ('If the operands are of unequal size, comparison proceeds as though the longer one was truncated on the right', §1985:IX.4.7.4 GR4); the 2002 START format prints the `[ WITH LENGTH arithmetic-expression-1 ]` bracket, §2002:14.8.37.2 SR8 reads 'If the LENGTH phrase is specified, file-name-1 shall reference a file with indexed organization' and §2002:14.8.37.3 GR13 'The value of arithmetic-expression-1 reflects the number of characters that will be used as a partial key for positioning to a record in file-name-1', and §2002:F.1 item 2 records the change through the status it adds: 'I-O status 23 has been expanded to include the case in which a START statement is attempted with an invalid key length specification'. §2014:14.9.37.2 SR8 and §2014:14.9.37.3 GR13 carry it, so 2014 = 2023. Gated on RECOGNITION in the VersionConformancePass parse arm (VisitStartWithLength -> 0900 below 2002); startKeyPhrase carries no version predicate, so an ill-organized or unbindable START still names the edition (kb/Work PB353).
display: the START KEY … WITH LENGTH phrase
vcr: 2002 introduction (§2002:14.8.37.2 SR8; §2002:F.1 item 2); W1.5 parse-layer mapping (DEVLOG 594)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. W15P.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F2 ASSIGN TO "f2.dat"
        ORGANIZATION INDEXED ACCESS DYNAMIC RECORD KEY RK.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F2.
01 R2.
   05 RK PIC X(5).
   05 RD2 PIC X(5).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    START F2 KEY = RK WITH LENGTH 3.
    STOP RUN.
